committee: * Presentation Notice for Legislative Certificate No. 352-38 (COR) - Office of Legislative Secretary Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane
title: Håfa Adai, Please join me in presenting Legislative Certificate No. 352-38 (COR), recognizing the Mayor of Piti, Honorable Jesse Alig and the Piti Municipal Planning Council (MPC) Members for their efforts in organizing and hosting the first-ever Piti Sea Festival. The festival, scheduled for April 18 and 19, 2026, celebrates Guam’s seafaring heritage and cultural traditions. The presentation is scheduled for Saturday, April 18, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. at Pedro Santos Park in Piti. For more information about the presentation, contact the Office of Legislative Secretary Senator Sabrina Salas Matana…
